title: Fix ITM comparison to preserve meaningful record-header differences
body:
Priority: **Critical**

The fallback skips AdditionalElementCount, including the record header, and can override a negative native equality result. Validation duplicates it. Share a canonical comparison that preserves meaningful flags; test flag-only overrides and ensure cleaning retains them.

Source evidence (reviewed checkout): `xEdit/xeMainForm.pas:1383; xEdit/xeAutomationCommandsValidation.pas:162; Core/wbImplementation.pas:12643`.

Acceptance requires implementation of the behavior above and reproducible regression checks for the described cases. Source-review finding; game-backed reproduction has not been run in this environment.

title: Add pipe deadlines and prevent stalled clients from blocking the daemon
body:
Priority: **High**

Synchronous FlushFileBuffers on the main thread can wait for a nonreading client. The client bounds open attempts but not response reads. Bound exchange waits, keep failures connection-local and verify stalled and disconnected clients do not wedge the daemon.

Source evidence (reviewed checkout): `xEdit/xeAutomationServeLoop.pas:280; xEdit/xeAutomationTransportPipe.pas:163`.

Acceptance requires implementation of the behavior above and reproducible regression checks for the described cases. Source-review finding; game-backed reproduction has not been run in this environment.

title: Handle oversized pipe messages without silent response loss
body:
Priority: **High**

The server relies on a fixed 4 MiB nonblocking message buffer; delivery can fail after a mutation has executed. Define advertised byte limits and reliable bounded framing/chunking or explicit oversized errors. Test boundary cases and ambiguous execution outcomes.

Source evidence (reviewed checkout): `xEdit/xeAutomationServeLoop.pas:43,156`.
